title: Line sketch: Vivid Wildflower Dance
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A dynamic arrangement of blooms including, and flowers set against swirling foliage and sky. Expressive and thick paint application create movement and energy throughout the page. The composition balances large central flowers with smaller accents in the foreground and background (derived from painting #83).
